method_summary: Reverse-engineered the label rule exactly (6131/6132 train match): Signal = 1[left-rise >= 0.00995] AND 1[right-rise >= 0.00995] in ln price (find_peaks(-log p, prominence=0.00995)). Left-rise is fully causal; right-rise depends on future prices (unpredictable part). Final score ranks gate rows by left-drop depth (P(right|depth) monotone on train), all leak-free (data <= t only, LR computed on concatenated train+test series).
